Row.Text: -Adds Serbia led by Stefan Uros IV Dušan. [NEWLINE]-Adds Stefan Uros IV Dušan as a leader of Byzantium and Greece. [NEWLINE]-Compatible with Strudeler's Civilization VI Deluxe, and (maybe) other leaders and civilizations created by Strudeler. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-Stefan Uros IV Dušan Trait/Dušan's Code: All Historic Moments gain an additional +1 Era Score. Gain the Alemannic Guard unique unit. [NEWLINE]-Stefan Uros IV Dušan Agenda/Emperor of Serbs and Greeks: Likes civilizations in a Golden Age. Dislikes civilizations in a Dark Age. [NEWLINE]-Stefan Uros IV Dušan Unit/Alemannic Guard: Replaces the Knight. Adjacent levied units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Cost to levy city-state units decreases by 10% [ICON_Gold] Gold for every Alemannic Guard during a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age. +50% Flanking bonus during a [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age. +1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy token point per turn for every Alemannic Guard during a [ICON_GLORY_DARK_AGE] Dark Age. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-Serbia Trait/Sclaveni: Civilian units gain +2 [ICON_Movement] Movement during a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age. Cities gain +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing during a [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age. Military or religious units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat or [ICON_Religion] Religious Strength during a [ICON_GLORY_DARK_AGE] Dark Age. [NEWLINE]-Serbia Unit/Gusar: Replaces the Courser. 1 [ICON_Range] Range. Can ranged attack when embarked. Can melee attack on land. +3 [ICON_Movement] Movement when embarked. Adjacent naval units can Coastal Raid. [NEWLINE]-Serbia Improvement/Autocephalous Church: +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing and [ICON_Faith] Faith. +2 Loyalty. +2 [ICON_GreatProphet] Great Prophet points per turn. Gain standard adjacency for various yields based on specialty districts, this becomes major adjacency with Nationalism. +15 HP healing for friendly religious units on the tile that has not attacked during the turn. A city can only have one Autocephalous Church. Tiles with an Autocephalous Church cannot be swapped. Cannot be built next to another Autocephalous Church. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]-This mod uses in-game assets remixed for the Alemannic Guard and Gusar. [NEWLINE]-Serbia uses Serbo-Croatian names (cities, geographic landmarks, citizens). [NEWLINE]-Serbia has alternate names available in the menu: Duklja, Rascia, Morava, Prilep, Serbo-Greece, and Serbo-Rome. [NEWLINE]-TSL support for Firaxis: Standard TSL Earth, Firaxis: Huge TSL Earth, Firaxis: Standard TSL Europe, Firaxis: TSL Mediterranean, YnAMP: Giant Earth, YnAMP: Greatest Earth Map, YnAMP: Large Europe, and YnAEMP: Play Europe Again. [NEWLINE]-Leader background for Stefan Uros IV Dušan (Serbia) created by Paja Jovanović; leader background for Stefan Uros IV Dušan (Byzantium) created by Alfonse Mucha; leader background for Stefan Uros IV Dušan (Greece) created by Paja Jovanović; moment art for the Alemannic Guard created by Adam Stefanović; moment art for the Gusar uploaded by G Ferg and taken from Pinterest; and moment art for the Autocephalous Church created by Vol de Nuit and taken from Wikipedia. [NEWLINE]-Leader art finalised using Image2Image. [NEWLINE]-Historic information can be found on Wikipedia.

[COLOR:Red]VERSION 1.2.3 (CURRENT)[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE]-Minor fixes. [NEWLINE]-Bonus [ICON_Housing] Housing during a [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age increased to +2. [NEWLINE]-Gusar embarked [ICON_Movement] Movement increased to +3.
[COLOR:Red]VERSION 1.2.2 (OLD)[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE]-Support for upcoming alternate leader: Njegoš. [NEWLINE]-Text changes.

[COLOR:Red]VERSION 1.2.0 (OLD)[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE]-New graphics. [NEWLINE]-Text changes. [NEWLINE]-Stefan Uros IV Dušan now has a unique unit: the Alemannic Guard. [NEWLINE]-Alemannic Guard: Serbian, Greek, and Byzantine unique Medieval era Heavy Cavalry class unit that replaces the Knight when Stefan Uros IV Dušan is their leader. Adjacent levied units gain +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Cost to levy city-state units decreases by 10% [ICON_Gold] Gold for every Alemannic Guard during a [ICON_GLORY_GOLDEN_AGE] Golden Age. +50% Flanking bonus during a [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age. +1 [ICON_Envoy] Envoy token point per turn for every Alemannic Guard during a [ICON_GLORY_DARK_AGE] Dark Age. [NEWLINE]-Sclaveni now grants cities +1 [ICON_Housing] Housing during a [ICON_GLORY_NORMAL_AGE] Normal Age. [NEWLINE]-Gusar [ICON_Gold] Gold maintenance lowered to 1 and it now costs 10 [ICON_Resource_Horses] Horses to build. [NEWLINE]-TSL support.

[COLOR:Red]VERSION 1.1.1 (OLD)[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE]-TSL support. [NEWLINE]-Gusar effects the Coastal Raid capabilities of adjacent ships and ships in formation with it. [NEWLINE]-Fixed Gusar sight from 5 to 2.
[COLOR:Red]VERSION 1.1.0 (OLD)[ENDCOLOR] [NEWLINE]-Changed Leader art. [NEWLINE]-Gusar now has an appropriate 5 [ICON_Movement] Movement.
